content.text: Submitted. The repair replaced the oversized rewrite of § 2(d) with a single concise `insert_after` subsection 2(e), leaving the existing sentence (and TrueLink's retained Interface rights, which now satisfy the pre-existing-IP element verbatim) byte-for-byte intact, dropping the undefined "Client Content" term, and keeping only preferred-level content: assignment/Client ownership of Support Services deliverables and work product, a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP, Client retention of its IP and data (subject to the § 8(d) Credit Data licence), and no joint ownership. Both official minimality gates now pass.
